payload.body_they: {{Name}} can look easygoing while making so many small adjustments for other people that their own needs barely enter the decision. They notice disappointment, stress, or discomfort quickly and may start accommodating it before anyone has asked. Resentment can arrive later, when other people were simply working from the answer {{Name}} gave them. The important difference is between choosing to be flexible and becoming so flexible that nobody has to find out what actually works for them.
